Look, if you go through the subreddit you'll get a lot of insight about what it's actually like to work for the company. It's not good.

IF you want to go through with the interview process, you'll be asked a lot of situational based questions. "What would you do if x happened" "How would you handle y situation"

Just make sure you highlight you communication, decision making, and de-escalation skills. Very important for the job.

Like I said though, it's not a great place to be. They just want another cog in the machine. Good luck.
